notes: Reviewed mill-script identity table (RM-1341 / GitHub #211 step 5). Every tracked path matching match_patterns must appear under scripts with a classification and canonical owner. Historical leftover generators stay recoverable on origin/legacy-mill-lane and as machine-local gitignored copies; they are not vendored onto main. Production mill detection, compose quarantine, training-audit mill prep, and cleaned mill-family packages remain in quality scope. Archiving is an explicit quality_scope=archived row or the historical_generator_policy, never a blanket *_mill.py / leftover / experiments/ suppress.
